concerns.text: T001 requires directory creation 'After `code/main.py --setup` … has created data/raw/, …' but `code/main.py` is not created until T009. This is a consumer-before-producer circularity: T001's verification (results/dir_listing.txt containing code/tests etc.) cannot pass at T001 time unless the `llmxive_toolkit.paths` fallback is made the primary, unconditional mechanism. Rewrite T001 to create directories via an explicit mkdir/setup step owned by T001 itself.

T009 states main.py runs '… → stats → sensitivity → aggregate', but `code/aggregate.py` is created in T010. The orchestrator references a module that no prior task produces. Either move aggregate.py creation into T009 or before it, or restrict T009's main.py chain to the modules that exist and add the aggregate stage in T010.

concerns.location: tasks.md:T008 [P] tag and 'Execution order: T007 ↔ T008'
concerns.text: T008 'merges [sensitivity_analysis] into results/statistical_result.json', which is produced by T007 — T008 is a consumer of T007's artifact, so the 'T007 ↔ T008' bidirectional order and both tasks' [P] tags are unsafe: running them in parallel risks T008 writing before/while T007 creates the file. Make the order strictly T007 → T008 and drop the [P] tag on T008 (or have T008 write only its own JSON and defer merging to T010).

concerns.location: tasks.md:[P] tags on T009, T010, T011, T012
concerns.text: T009 runs the full pipeline end-to-end (consumes outputs of T003–T008), T010 consumes monitoring.csv + statistical_result.json produced by T009's run, T011 consumes combined_metrics.parquet and statistical_result.json from T010, and T12 re-runs main.py and hashes statistical_result.json. None of these are parallel-safe; tagging them [P] implies they can run concurrently with their producers. Remove the [P] tags from T009–T012 (and similarly T004/T005/T006 all consume T003's manifest and append to the shared results/monitoring.csv — shared-state appends make even those unsafe to run concurrently with each other).

concerns.location: tasks.md:T006 placement vs 'Checkpoint' and US grouping
concerns.text: T006 is tagged [US2] but sits in Phase 1 before the checkpoint that explicitly says main.py (T009) is what makes the story testable end-to-end. The US-2 block (T006 alone) is not independently shippable without T003–T005; consider either moving T006 into a Phase-1b/US-2 section after the checkpoint or noting the intra-phase ordering T003→T004→T005→T006 explicitly in the execution-order line (currently only 'T001 → … → T006' implies it, which is acceptable, but the checkpoint text referencing T009 mid-list is confusing).
